verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: quote, attribution and logo on one left edge, with the can centred on the circle in the bottom-right. Its flaws are a quote set smaller than the canvas allows, a tiny logo, an oversized circle and a dead gap between the attribution and the can. B enlarges the quote but breaks the layout: the logo floats centred and off the left text edge, the attribution is jammed against the top of the circle, and the shrunken can straddles the circle's edge with an unreadable SOLSTICE label, so placement looks arbitrary.
